summary: Verified new PASSPORT feature end-to-end (Jan 2026 sprint). Generated a PNG passport (REPUBLIC OF INDIA PASSPORT · Passport No.: Z7654321 · Surname: SHARMA · Given Name(s): ANITA DEVI · Date of Expiry: 15/03/2027) and ran 3 real Gemini OCR uploads against a throwaway member (TEST Anita Sharma). All OCR results came back with number=Z7654321, name=ANITA DEVI SHARMA, expiry=2027-03-15 (perfect). Name-match logic verified exactly as spec'd: expected='TEST Anita Sharma' → name_matches=false; expected='anita   devi SHARMA' (same words, case/extra spaces ignored) → name_matches=true; expected='Sharma Anita Devi' (reordered) → name_matches=false. Member edit form shows id-docs-section titled 'PAN, AADHAAR & PASSPORT (ADMINS ONLY)' with 3 cards per person; all passport testids present (id-self-passport-number / -expiry (type=date) / -upload / -file-input / -view / -remove). After PUT /id-docs with {passport:'Z7654321', passport_expiry:'2027-03-15'} the form repoens prefilled Z7654321 / 2027-03-15. ID Documents report (/admin/id-documents) renders new columns Passport no. / Passport scan / Expiry; our row shows passport=Z7654321, passport-scan tick (empty text — icon only), passport-expiry='2027-03-15 · soon' (amber, within 6 months of today 2026-10-09). Missing filter has new 'passport' and 'expiring' options (verified via option values ['any','pan','aadhaar','passport','expiring','scans','all']). 'expiring' filter keeps our row (passport_status='soon'), 'passport' filter hides it (because scan is uploaded + number is filled, not missing). Bulk read endpoint returns {detected:{type:'passport',number:'Z7654321',name:'ANITA DEVI SHARMA',expiry:'2027-03-15',name_matches:false}, match:{member_id,...}, score:1.0}. Members Columns menu has new 'Passport' entry with NEW badge (col-toggle-passport); toggling shows col-head-passport; inline-passport-<id> cell displays saved number; entering invalid '12' triggers backend 400 and toast 'Passport number must be 6–9 letters/digits' (from server, Request ID included) — DB value unchanged (confirmed via GET: passport still Z7654321 in form). Invalid expiry 'not-a-date' → 400 'Passport expiry must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD)'. 1 throwaway member created via POST /api/members and DELETEd (200); verified by GET returning 404.

issues: The row cell data-testid='id-row-<id>-<person>-passport-scan' renders the <Check /> icon with no accompanying text, so a Playwright text_content() shows an empty string. Not a bug for users (green tick is visually clear + title='On file'), but automation would benefit from an aria-label or hidden text like 'On file' / 'Missing' on the icon.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/id_docs.py _expiry_status() clamps day to min(d,28) when adding 6 months — correct for avoiding Feb overflow, but means a passport expiring on 2027-02-28 vs a 'today' of 2026-08-29 is treated as 'soon' only because the comparison upper bound is clamped to day<=28. Edge case is tiny but worth a code comment. Logic verified in practice: 2027-03-15 vs 2026-10-09 correctly returned 'soon'.

backend/routes/id_docs.py PUT /id-docs correctly validates each field independently and raises before any Mongo $set, so a single invalid field (e.g. passport='12') cannot partially overwrite others. Confirmed via curl: invalid passport returns 400 and existing Z7654321 is preserved in DB (member form re-opened shows Z7654321 after the invalid attempt).

frontend/IdDocsSection.jsx DetectedBar name warning text for passport reads 'passport: ANITA DEVI SHARMA · database: TEST Anita Sharma' — matches the task spec exactly. Confirm&save button correctly bundles number + expiry into one PUT body (see confirm() in IdDocsSection.jsx:152).
frontend/IdReport.jsx Expiry component correctly shows '· expired' for past dates and '· soon' for within 6 months with proper color classes. Verified 'soon' badge displayed with amber background.

frontend/BulkIdUpload.jsx RowEditor renders the Passport-row 'expires …' line and the 'Not exactly the database name' warning only when card==='passport' and nameMatches===false. Card dropdown lists PAN / Aadhaar / Passport. backend /id-docs/bulk/read returned {detected:{type:'passport', name_matches:false}, score:1.0} proving auto-type + exact-name is wired through.

columns.jsx idCell('passport') uses the same InlineCell pattern as PAN/Aadhaar — regression-safe. Toast on 400 is from the shared showApiError path; the inline cell's optimistic blank during the failed save is a minor UX quirk (display briefly shows '—' before the next render re-fetches), but server data is never corrupted.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 scenarios: OCR mismatched name, OCR exact name case+spaces, OCR reordered name, PUT passport+expiry save+persist, PUT invalid passport→400, PUT invalid expiry→400, bulk/read)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (member form id-docs section, report columns+filters, Members columns menu + inline edit + invalid-value toast)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The OCR calls are REAL Gemini and take ~15-25s each. Running 2-3 OCR calls inside a single Playwright script blew the browser automation tool's internal timeout — split the test: do OCR via curl against /api/members/<id>/id-docs/self/passport (backend returns detected directly) and use Playwright only for UI structure/testid checks. The sidebar covers the Columns menu drawer on 1600px width; use 1900px viewport or dispatch click via element.click() in page.evaluate. InlineCell swaps DOM between display button and input but keeps the same data-testid, so page.locator('[data-testid=inline-passport-<id>]').click() then .fill(x).press('Enter') works. The admin email login lands on '/' (not /admin/*); navigate explicitly to /admin/members or /admin/id-documents after login. There is an 'Approvals · 9 corrections waiting' banner at top but it does not block interactions.
flows_verified: GET /api/members/{mid}/id-docs returns people/allowed_people — includes passport_file meta after upload.

POST /api/members/{mid}/id-docs/self/passport (ocr=true) returns detected.type='passport', detected.number='Z7654321', detected.name='ANITA DEVI SHARMA', detected.expiry='2027-03-15', detected.expected_name=<db name>, detected.name_matches follows name_exact(passport_name, db_name). Case + collapsed-whitespace match PASSES; reorder FAILS.
PUT /api/members/{mid}/id-docs with {people:{self:{passport,passport_expiry}}} saves both fields; passport cleaned to upper+no-whitespace; expiry validated as YYYY-MM-DD.
GET /api/id-docs/report rows include passport, passport_scan (bool), passport_expiry, passport_status ('expired'|'soon'|'ok'|''); 2027-03-15 vs today 2026-10-09 → 'soon'.

POST /api/id-docs/bulk/read auto-detects type='passport', suggests matching member via name_score, includes name_matches when a match is found + card is passport. For 'Sharma Anita Devi' vs 'ANITA DEVI SHARMA' → name_matches:false, score:1.0 (score matches by sorted-token overlap, name_matches is strict exact-order).

Member form id-docs-section title 'PAN, Aadhaar & Passport (admins only)'; 3 cards per person (self only for staff category); id-

-passport-number / -expiry (type=date) / -upload / -file-input / -view / -remove all present; prefilled from server.

Members table col-toggle-passport (NEW badge) toggles col-head-passport; inline-passport-<id> edits via PUT /id-docs; invalid '12' → 400 + sonner toast 'Passport number must be 6–9 letters/digits · Request ID …'; DB value preserved (verified via member form re-open).
/admin/id-documents filter id-report-missing has options passport + expiring; expiring filter correctly shows rows with passport_status in {expired, soon}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only a minor automation-friendly suggestion to add aria-label='on file'|'missing' to the passport-scan tick icon so Playwright text assertions can distinguish present vs missing without pattern-matching on inner SVG.
